sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(s.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount,
    round(sum(s.DiscountAmount) / sum(sum(s.DiscountAmount)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS SharePercent,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(s.DiscountAmount) DESC) AS Rnk
FROM retail.FactSales s
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON s.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY Rnk
